{{Top|canon=Supreme Leader (Confederacy of Independent Systems)}}
{{Quote|Small, huh? Don't worry, Supreme Leader, we'll take care of him.|A [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 3 (Rugosa)/Legends|B1 battle droid]] to Asajj Ventress|<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>}}
'''Supreme Leader''' was a title.

==History==
[[File:TCW_Ventress_battalion.png|thumb|220x220px|A [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of the [[T81 Division|division]] commanded by Asajj Ventress]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was referred to as Supreme Leader by her forces at the [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|Mission to Rugosa]]<ref name="Ambush" /> and the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]].<ref name="TCW 8">[[The Clone Wars 8|''The Clone Wars'' 8]]</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the title was taken by several [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlords]].
